cases.case_label: AluYa8 in exon 9 of MAK (Ashkenazi founder)
cases.mechanism_detail: An Alu insertion (280 bp Alu + ~60 bp polyA + 13 bp TSD) in MAK exon 9, previously shown to disrupt splicing and abolish mature MAK protein; here detected in silico, solving one homozygous patient and one compound heterozygote with p.Gly16Arg (plus three heterozygous carriers).
cases.quote: Bioinformatics analysis of the MAK-Alu insertion showed that it belongs to a relatively recently evolved AluYa8 subfamily
